outcome: APGAR score of less than 7 at 5 minutes
cohort: 200 patients with singleton pregnancies were divided into two groups: 100 requiring induction of labor and 100 with spontaneous onset of labor.
finding: The induction of labor was associated with an increased rate of cesarean section, low APGAR score (<7) at 5 minutes, and NICU admission, but showed no association with uterine rupture or primary Post-partum hemorrhage.
mod_finding: Patients undergoing induction of labor had a statistically significant higher rate of cesarean sections compared to those with spontaneous labor.
